CPSC Featured Image

Never Leave Squishy Toys in Hot Cars

Squishy toys left in hot cars can reach internal temperatures of over 150 degrees. Keep squishy toys cool and never heat squishy toys in the microwave or anywhere else. Burns from squishy toys have sent children to the ER with severe injuries. In this photo, a CPSC toy safety engineer is about to squeeze a hot squishy toy while filming a public service announcement. CPSC’s toy lab tests all kinds of toys to see if they meet safety standards or should be recalled.
